# Frozen comparison
Use the digest and item key in the sibling second_panel audit. Restrict to panels of size at least two. Assign questions to five folds by SHA256 of UTF8 str(qid) modulo five. Cross-fit item-weighted marginal mean m and distinct-pair product moment t. Beta-binomial moment EB predicts m+r(x-m), where r is (t-m²)/(m(1-m)) bounded to [0,1]. Compare observed vote, training mean, and matched fixed concentration 2 with the same training mean (two prior pseudo-votes, analogous to add-one smoothing at mean 0.5). Also evaluate classical Laplace add-one (x+1)/3. Score every ordered pair of distinct judgments, averaging within item then across items. Clip every probability at 0.01 and 0.99 for both scores. Report paired differences EB minus comparator, Brier and natural log loss, with question-cluster normal intervals conditional on fitted folds. No tuning, rater features or text. This is anonymous prediction of a second answer-equivalence judgment on repeatedly rated items.
